purpose: P0.3 capture protocol: ten samples for each of ten disclosure types, each with manual ground truth. Slots are named `<category>-01` to `<category>-10` and are `pending_capture` unless `slots` says otherwise. A slot becomes `captured` only when the original bytes are archived (sha256) and a person has recorded the expected parsed fields. No slot is pre-filled with invented values.
adjudication: Every `captured` slot is read by a person before it becomes ground truth. A `captured_model_checked` slot was checked against the original source by the model (2026-10-08) and still needs a person's read before it counts toward a release gate; disagreements are kept in `expected_notes`.
